question: In a colorectal cancer study utilizing bulk rna seq, An analyst evaluates Random Forest Gini impurity importance vs Permutation Importance on a test set containing highly collinear gene co-expression modules, noting Gini importance strongly biases toward high-variance genes. How should this analysis be evaluated and executed?
proposed_analysis: Proposed analysis: An analyst evaluates Random Forest Gini impurity importance vs Permutation Importance on a test set containing highly collinear gene co-expression modules, noting Gini importance strongly biases toward high-variance genes.
preferred_analysis: Scientifically sound comparison: Gini impurity importance systematically overestimates continuous/high-cardinality features and distorts correlated gene modules. Permutation importance or grouped-feature importance provides more reliable attributions.
